okr.okrSystemEnabled: When enabled, all members and AI agents in the organization can use OKR to manage objectives. The OKR Agent will proactively track and report progress.
okr.chooseCadenceFirst: Choose OKR cadence before first enablement
okr.chooseCadenceDesc: Choose quarterly or monthly. After OKR is enabled for the first time, this cadence will be locked to keep history and reports consistent.
okr.companyObjectivesDesc: Company objectives are recorded for the current period. Visit the OKR page to view details or nudge members to set their individual OKRs.
okr.firstStepDesc: The first step after enabling OKR is to let the OKR Agent record your company objectives. Click the button to open a chat with the OKR Agent and describe your goals for this period.
okr.cadenceLocked: OKR cadence is locked and cannot be changed
okr.cadenceLockedDesc: The OKR cadence is locked after first enablement so history, reports, and nudges keep one consistent meaning.
okr.enableMemberDailyDesc: Members only submit daily reports. The company daily report is generated at 09:00 the next day, and weekly/monthly summaries are generated automatically.
okr.timezoneDesc: Scheduled collection currently follows the company timezone: {{timezone}}
okr.timezoneWarning: Your company timezone is still UTC. If you expect China local time, update Company Info to China / Asia/Shanghai first.
okr.scheduleDesc: At this time each day, the OKR Agent starts collecting member daily reports. The company daily report is generated at 09:00 the next day, the weekly report at 09:00 every Monday, and the monthly report at 09:00 on the 1st of each month.
